name: Oathkeeper's Vow
text:
**Oathkeeper's Vow** (religion trait; Kols)

The clergy of Kols trained you to make unbreakable vows. You add the following spells to the paladin spell list at the indicated levels: command (1st), forbid action (1st), suggestion (to fulfill a prior promise only; 2nd), lesser geas (3rd), geas/quest (4th).
